examples.english: The headteacher has to make an effort to set an example.
examples.persian: مدیر مدرسه باید تلاش کند تا الگو باشد.

miniContext: The headteacher obviously has to make an effort to set an example to their staff and students.

examples.english: The headteacher has to set a good example to their staff and students.
examples.persian: مدیر مدرسه باید برای کارکنان و دانش‌آموزانش الگوی خوبی باشد.

miniContext: It is their job to set a good example to their staff and students.

meaning: با احترام با کسی رفتار کردن

examples.english: It is their job to treat everyone with respect.
examples.persian: وظیفه آن‌ها این است که با همه با احترام رفتار کنند.

miniContext: It is their job to treat everyone with respect.

meaning: مسئولیت چیزی را بر عهده گرفتن

examples.english: It is their job to take responsibility for important decisions.

miniContext: It is their job to take responsibility for important decisions that the school makes.

meaning: تحسین و اعتبار کاری را گرفتن

examples.english: If things go well, the headteacher gets the credit.
examples.persian: اگر همه چیز خوب پیش برود، مدیر مدرسه اعتبارش را می‌گیرد.

miniContext: If things go well, the headteacher gets the credit; if they don't, he or she has to take the blame.

meaning: مسئولیت اشتباه یا شکست را پذیرفتن

examples.english: He or she has to be prepared to take the blame.
examples.persian: او باید آماده باشد که تقصیر را بپذیرد.

miniContext: If things don't go well, he or she has to be prepared to take the blame.

examples.english: Carrie had been spreading a rumour that Sean and Sophie were going to have a baby.
examples.persian: کری داشت این شایعه را پخش می‌کرد که شان و سوفی قرار است بچه‌دار شوند.

miniContext: Carrie had been spreading a rumour that Sean and Sophie were going to have a baby.

examples.english: Sean finally broke the news that they were going to get a cat.
